# Harnez Rules

Generated by `harnez init`; do not edit. Read these rules in addition to AGENTS.md:

> This repo does not use file-based issues; skip those steps and use the repo's own tracker.
> When its tickets live on the forge of the origin remote (no numbered issues/ tracker or `issues/README.md`; `issues/inbox/` alone stays on the forge), search with `harnez find -d . issues "<terms>"`,
> read with `harnez issues show N`, and file with `harnez issues new "<title>" -F <body-file> [--label L]`;
> each prints the forge repo. Ask before commenting on an existing ticket, and report "filed as #N at <URL>; no commit".
> If forge filing fails (missing write access, token, CLI auth, or worker session), `harnez issues new` falls back to writing `issues/inbox/<slug>.md` (or use `--inbox` directly) — never scaffold `issues/001-*.md` or `issues/README.md`, and never inspect or troubleshoot forge token setup; commit and push the draft on a branch/PR or hand it back to the host. Note any `harnez` filing friction briefly or via `harnez feedback issue "<description>"`.

> This repo does not use indexed studies; skip those steps.
